value.value: Final LEET is reported around 580–585 nm after stated 1, 5 or 30 min delays versus about 575 nm for co-injection. The 1-min branch has comparable dispersity; 5/30-min dispersity degrades unless additional indium myristate is used. Main results, detailed method and SI panel coverage do not map every outcome to the same branch/extra-indium condition.
